authorization: The one frozen post-chart development replay produced 604 completed Bull trades with 6.4246 percent mean net return. Combined with the two unchanged Bear mechanisms it produced 2,669 completed signals, more than 50 in every 2014-2020 year, 4.7936 percent pooled mean net return, positive median, and 9.2169 percent severe-loss incidence.

stage_a.requirement: Materialize all mother identities, contemporaneous same-date event breadth, frozen market-lifecycle rules, two-session acceptance observations, and final accepted identities before attaching any target, exit, or return outcome.
stage_a.right_censor_rule: For 2024, retain an accepted confirmation only when confirmation_cal_idx plus the maximum three-session entry grace, thirty held sessions, and one next-open time-stop execution session does not exceed the final 2024 exchange cal_idx. This outcome-blind lifecycle-completeness rule prevents any 2025 bar read.

bull_rules.mother: Exact frozen V1 mother: causal BULL; causal PIT industry with at least ten members, positive median ret20 and positive-ret20 share at least 0.55; stock was in the prior session's bottom industry ret20 quartile; first qualifying event in twenty sessions; signal return at least 5 percent; close location at least 0.80; turnover at least 1.5 times prior-twenty median; non-upper-limit close.
bull_rules.market_lifecycle: At mother signal close, same-date mother-event count at least six and either market median ret20 at least 3 percent or market median ret20 at least market median ret60; exclude market median ret60 at least 20 percent while market median ret20 is at most 10 percent.
bull_rules.absolute_non_chaser: Prior-session stock ret20 strictly below 20 percent.
bull_rules.acceptance: Both next consecutive exchange sessions are valid, tradable, hard-valid, corporate-action-safe, on unchanged coordinate lineage, and close at or above the mother signal coordinate close.
bull_rules.confirmation_market: Causal market state remains BULL at the second acceptance close.
bull_rules.entry: First legal non-limit-up open in confirmation+1 through confirmation+3.
bull_rules.exit: 15 percent coordinate-price target or first legal open after 30 held sessions.

unchanged_bear_components.source: Reuse exact already-produced V20 validation Bear-fast and Bear-slow outcome ledgers; do not rebuild, tune, or attach the new Bull rules to them.

union.route: BULL uses only accepted industry-laggard diffusion; BEAR uses the unchanged fast and slow repair ledgers; TRANSITION holds cash.
union.deduplication: For identical symbol and confirmation/signal date retain Bear-fast, then Bear-slow, then Bull, followed by event id. Priority is frozen and not payoff-selected.

evaluation.primary: Completed event-level net economics pooled and by signal year.
evaluation.written_gate: More than 50 combined completed signals in each year; pooled mean net return strictly above 4 percent; pooled median positive; severe-loss incidence at most 20 percent.
evaluation.strict_diagnostic: Also report whether each validation-year mean net return exceeds 4 percent.
